title: Client home for free paths
text: Home-derived free paths, including standard user cache roots, use the executing client's canonical home fact. When a refused absolute operand resembles a home-derived free path and that fact is missing or invalid, the shared guard names client_home_metadata_missing_or_invalid and teaches the session to update the CLI with yoke update and retry. Recognizing the shape supplies a diagnosis only; it grants no path authority. A valid client-home fact admits the client's standard cache paths. Observed in source and regression tests; live installed delivery is not established by these checks.
